description: This file contains report generation logic for customer acquisition and loyalty analysis in an ERP system, including data retrieval and aggregation functions based on time and territory.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate customer acquisition and loyalty report based on filters.

methods.name: get_data_by_time
methods.description: Retrieves and formats data grouped by month within a date range.

methods.name: get_data_by_territory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats data grouped by territory, including hierarchy processing.

methods.name: get_customer_stats
methods.description: Calculates number of new and repeat customers and their revenue, optionally structured for a tree view.
